title: Polar H10 HRV Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:hrv
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by measurement_type
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Polar H10 HRV session data has stopped arriving for a given measurement type.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per measurement type and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It scores when one part of your Polar H10 HRV session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
